subject: POC prompt set & eval plan follow-up and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Ortiz <jamie.ortiz@acmehealth.com>, Saeed Khan <saeed.khan@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff recap - prompt set & next steps

Hi Jamie + Saeed,

Thanks for a productive kickoff today - really appreciate the clarity on your primary goal (automating triage summaries for clinician notes) and the constraints around PHI, retention, and latency. Per the call, here are the concrete next steps so we can get the evaluation dataset and run the POC: 

1) You to share a representative prompt set + 200 anonymized sample notes or a synthetic equivalent. CSV or JSONL is fine; column headers for prompt/context/expected_output are ideal.
2) Redwood will provide an evaluation plan doc with success criteria and the scoring rubric (precision/recall-style checks, hallucination thresholds, latency targets).
3) Ownership: Jamie - data and clinical leads for sample preparation; Saeed - security/compliance contact for anonymization & transfer; Marissa - POC owner for success criteria and schedule; Aditya - inference runtime lead; Connor - evaluation and metrics.
4) Timeline: target ingest of dataset by Mar 25; baseline runs and first eval by Apr 1; iteration + recommendations by Apr 8.

I attached a draft eval plan and an example CSV template (acme_prompts_v1.csv). Please confirm you can share the samples by EOD 3/25 and whether you need Redwood's SFTP or prefer a secure Drive link.

Thanks - looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Thanks Marissa - this is great and matches our notes. Quick answers: 

- We'll provide a CSV with 250 de-identified clinician notes and a matching prompt column. Saeed is validating anonymization today.
- For transfer, please share SFTP details - we need to avoid public Drive links for the samples.
- Timeline: EOD 3/25 for delivery looks doable but Saeed will confirm by tomorrow.

A couple of clarifying Qs: 
1) On success criteria, can you confirm the latency SLO you used for initial planning (95th percentile token latency)?
2) For evaluation, do you accept a mixed-format CSV (some rows with expected_json for structured outputs)?

On the security side, Saeed will loop in our privacy counsel if he needs more info about your KMS/HSM setup.

- Jamie
Jamie Ortiz
